text:
jordan: Following up from the incident postmortem: we need to lock owners and deadlines for the observability pipeline fixes (missing spans, bad rollup counts, and ETL lag). I'll paste the action list and ask owners to confirm.

maya: Thanks. Short root cause recap: transient exporter 502/504s caused drops at the collector + a LEFT JOIN-to-GROUP bug in the rollup job that ignored nulls. Together they produced undercounts in dashboards and alerted customers.

leo: I can pick up the collector-side retry+buffer. Plan: implement a bounded in-memory queue per-shard, add async retry with jitter, and surface queue metrics. Will ship a canary to 10% of shards. ETA: 2026-03-26. Opening WIP PR today.

nina-analytics: I'll handle the rollup fix and add schema-level guards: coalesce keys before grouping, add test fixtures for null-key traces, and add a nightly consistency job that compares raw span counts -> aggregated counts. ETA: 2026-03-19.

sam-sre: I'll own alerts + runbook updates. Proposal: add low-ingest alert if span_rate < 60% baseline for 10m (P2), and critical if <40% for 3m (P1). Runbook to include collector shard restart and exporter healthcheck. Also will add a post-deploy smoke test for exporter performance. ETA: 2 days.

opsbot: rollout: obs-collector v2.1.5 -> v2.1.6 deployed prod-canary at 2026-03-09T09:14Z.

jordan: Action snapshot (captured into the PM doc):

```
action,owner,eta,status,notes
collector-buffer,leo,2026-03-26,open,canary to 10% shards
rollup-null-guard,nina-analytics,2026-03-19,in-progress,unit+integration tests
ingest-alerts,sam-sre,2026-03-11,open,add runbook + SLOs
reconciliation-script,nina-analytics,2026-03-18,open,backfill if gaps>2h
weekly-audit,maya,2026-04-15,open,quarterly reliability review
```

jordan: Note on recurring pattern: this is incident #4 with similar symptoms in the last 12 months. Suggesting a dedicated "exporter/collector stability" spike to harden the handshake and telemetry.

maya: Agree. I'll schedule a 2-week spike for the reliability team next sprint. We'll include load-tests that simulate 5xxs and network flaps.

leo: quick log snippet I pulled that coincided with the gap:
```
[2026-03-09T08:57:03Z] WARN exporter: write failed (status=502) id=abc shard=3 retry=0
[2026-03-09T08:57:03Z] INFO collector: dropped 120 spans due to full_write_queue shard=3
```

nina-analytics: For the reconciliation job, do we want aggressive backfills? My plan: detect windows where aggregated_count < raw_ingest_count * 0.9 and trigger backfill for that window automatically (with operator approval for >48h ranges).

sam-sre: Sounds reasonable. Add a manual override flag and rate-limit the backfill to avoid overloading the cluster. Also add a dashboard card for in-progress backfills.

jordan: Please put PR links and status updates into the doc. I'll run check-ins Mon/Wed until all items are closed. If any owner misses ETA by >3 days without update, we escalate to the reliability spike lead.

maya: Accepted. I'll follow up with the spike scope.

sam-sre: Accepted ownership of alerts/runbook. :white_check_mark:

leo: Accepted ownership of collector-buffer. :white_check_mark:

nina-analytics: Accepted for rollup & reconciliation. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical follow-up. React here if any changes.
